summary: The original task-board/cross-team job fails in the later oversized-comment cold-renderer wait. Earlier retained subflow PASS states remain separate. A new document was loaded, but its main module import failed with recorded Script ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES and a TypeError for /main.tsx. No comment UI action or complete oversized-comment rendering proof followed. The existing initial loader has no failure handler, but correcting that reporting gap alone cannot restore or qualify the failed E2E.

method.allowed: Immutable Git/source/retained evidence reads and pure memory parsing/identity comparisons; one bare advisory blob.
method.performed: Complete packet and complete receipt transport/hash/JSON validation. Full retained rendererDiagnostics and rendererFailureSnapshot, including every retained event and resource row, were read. Ten complete decisive source bodies were read. Complete app log and artifact log were read; the original job log was fully fetched/hashed and its tuple, invocation, original failure, assertion, exit and archive publication sections read.
method.boundedReceiptScope: The large receipt contains earlier task snapshots and receipts. This advisory reads preceding proof status/source/sequence metadata and the complete failure/diagnostic/custody sections; it does not claim a new full semantic audit of every earlier task-board business receipt.
method.screenshots: PNG/member identities are retained by the capture packet. This reviewer did not visually inspect those PNGs or independently reopen the ZIP.

The later document reaches DOM/load readiness and can answer the Main startup bridge, while React/store initialization in the new document remains absent. Document readiness and Main readiness do not prove the renderer module graph loaded.

diagnostics.networkFailureShape: Every one of the45 retained failure rows is type Script, canceled false and net::ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES. The rows omit requestId and URL; adjacent Log.entryAdded paths are separately retained observations, not a proven per-request join.

entryException.moduleError: TypeError: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: /main.tsx

limits: The first96 event slots are full. The number45 is a retained lower bound on the recorded failure population, not an uncapped total.
Only the last160 same-origin entries available from ResourceTiming were returned. That successful subset is not a complete request census, and it does not prove failed requests later completed.
Network failure rows lack request identifiers and resource allocation/limit measurements.
No memory, file-descriptor, resource-dispatcher or concurrent-request threshold is proved by the error code alone.
Failure snapshot follows the timeout; it is an observation, not an atomic snapshot at the exact first network error.

sourceDiagnosis.loader: The complete frozen index.html makes an unawaited, uncaught import('./main.tsx') in its final inline module. The static splash exists before that import. Failure is not handled by an entry-owned terminal state.
sourceDiagnosis.main: The complete main.tsx imports App, store, Sentry, telemetry and styles before its top-level statements. It registers dynamic-import recovery before mount but only after the module's eager dependencies load. It cannot install that listener when the entry graph itself fails.
sourceDiagnosis.recovery: The complete utility handles vite:preloadError, calls preventDefault and schedules window.location.reload with a10-second sessionStorage throttle. Moving or expanding that automatic retry is not recommended or selected by this advisory.
sourceDiagnosis.splash: The observed Preparing workspace... is the initial static text from index.html. Main's ready response does not update it because the main renderer module did not initialize.
sourceDiagnosis.devRoute: The original app log records Vite6.4.4 development serving at localhost:5173. The complete config contains optimizeDeps include/exclude rules and a production Rollup openui-icons chunk rule; the latter is not evidence of equivalent chunking of the development request graph.
sourceDiagnosis.resourceRootCause: The artifacts identify module loading as the failed stage but do not prove the exact exhausted resource or the smallest resource-restoring implementation. No memory/request/descriptor diagnosis is substituted for missing measurements.
sourceDiagnosis.lateAppLog: The app log later ends with network-service restart and GPU launch/fatal messages during shutdown. The retained failure and cleanup record already show a guarded close timeout and group SIGTERM. Those late log messages are preserved without promoting them to the cause of the earlier main import failure.

sourceCustody.qualification: The complete immutable bodies of those three missing-row files were read at the frozen source head, but this capture has no individual physical before/after SHA rows for them and no full served-renderer-body attestation. This is a retained evidence limit, not a finding that the files changed.
sourceCustody.bundleProvenance: Actual compiled main/preload JS bytes hashed after owned app startup; no claim of reproducible source-to-bundle rebuild
sourceCustody.noNewCensus: No working tree, filesystem, binary or live process was inspected in this review.

finalSentinelCensus.qualification: Only finite sentinel version checks and the isolated shell-environment fixture are admitted; any native/control fallback before or after Quit makes this provider-emulation proof incomplete.

cleanup.qualification: The wrapper received SIGTERM through the guarded captured-group fallback. Empty final group and Host absence are retained observations after harness cleanup; app normal exit and Host exit/signal status are not established. No native custody, ordinary Quit or full E2E PASS is inferred.

boundedNextAdvice.sourceSupportedReportingCandidate: If root selects a separate source correction, the existing initial loader can own an explicit rejection/failure state before main.tsx. It should retain the original import error and stop claiming that preparation is progressing. This is a concrete product error-reporting gap, not a repair of the underlying resource failure.
reportingSemantics: Keep the successful import and normal mounting route unchanged.
On entry import rejection, report a terminal startup failure without requiring the failing main graph to load.
Do not mark UI initialized, remove the splash as success, substitute alternate UI, issue another import, reload the page or retry the journey.
Retain the original failure and existing cleanup/result accounting.
boundedNextAdvice.functionalFixObligation: Before selecting a functional module-loading correction, establish from primary source and bounded original observations which request/allocation limit failed and how the proposed source change prevents that failure. A development dependency-fan-out change might be a candidate only if that link is proved; this capture alone does not establish it.
boundedNextAdvice.meaningfulFutureVerification: Any eventual resource correction must still execute the original cold reload and the unchanged full oversized-comment assertions: exact original task/comment identity, real controls, all Unicode content and no canonical command/task replay. A finite entry-error test can discriminate correct failure reporting but cannot stand in for that E2E.
notSupported: Dropping/splitting away the cold-renderer or oversized-comment assertions to obtain PASS
Changing user-content size to avoid the obligation
Treating Main ready or DOM complete as renderer-ready
Promoting cleanup absence to normal exit
Selecting a memory/FD/request-limit fix from the error string alone
boundedNextAdvice.scopeIsolation: This advisory does not amend accepted R1b16bf or its future exact source/control R2, and it does not authorize mutation or polling of frozen PR1218.
